The separately accepted [C-deletion table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_five_scenes_20261010/snapshot/TABLES.md) contains 50 minus_C checkpoints paired by scene and seed with 50 existing Full checkpoints across IID Benign, F Flip, FedSA, S-DFA and Sp-DFA. Deleting C removes its score contribution while geometric hard filtering remains enabled. For IID Benign, the paired native/shared ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences (minus_C−Full) are -0.083±1.378 / +0.00292±0.01315 / -0.00142±0.01953, with ACC in percentage points. For IID F Flip they are +0.518±0.814 / +0.00139±0.01487 / +0.01098±0.02176. These are paired means ± sample SD: deleting C raises F Flip accuracy while increasing both measured disparities. The table retains raw, native and shared views and the same 10/9/6-seed panels. C remains incomplete over the four non-IID attack scenes; A, F, V, norm treatment, hard filtering and candidate selection remain outside these image conclusions.

**Non-IID Benign C-deletion extension.** The accepted [six-scene table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_six_scenes_20261010/snapshot/TABLES.md) adds ten matched non-IID Benign pairs, using the same round-70 checkpoint per model and 19,867 validation images. Native/shared Full ACC/AEOD/ASPD are 88.594 ± 1.168 / 0.00696 ± 0.00423 / 0.06511 ± 0.00902, compared with 89.188 ± 0.789 / 0.00615 ± 0.00668 / 0.06778 ± 0.00453 after deleting C (ACC in percent; gaps on [0,1]). The paired differences (minus_C−Full) are +0.594 ± 0.795 / -0.00081 ± 0.00644 / +0.00267 ± 0.00947 in native/shared and +0.641 ± 0.802 / +0.00105 ± 0.00915 / +0.00198 ± 0.00656 in raw, with ACC differences in percentage points; all triplets are means ± sample SD (ddof=1) across matched seeds. Removing C therefore increases accuracy in both views, lowers the native/shared AEOD mean slightly but increases ASPD, and increases both raw disparity means. These are retained trade-offs, not evidence that C benefits every metric or is universally indispensable. In the fixed nine- and six-seed native/shared panels, the corresponding paired triplets are +0.659 ± 0.814 / -0.00074 ± 0.00683 / +0.00332 ± 0.00980 and +0.518 ± 0.545 / -0.00000 ± 0.00681 / +0.00264 ± 0.00655. The accuracy and ASPD directions persist; the six-seed AEOD mean difference is close to zero (the displayed value rounds to zero), not evidence of equivalence. No significance or isolated aggregation-causality claim follows from these descriptive comparisons.

**C60 scope and comparability.** Only five IID scenarios and non-IID Benign are complete; the four non-IID attack scenarios and six other image controls remain incomplete. Native/shared metrics and saved group counts coincide for all 120 C60 records; the views are not independent replications. Full replay uses five CPU and 55 GPU records, with 59 cu128 and one cu130 training checkpoints; all 60 minus_C records use CPU replay and cu128 training. These C60 counts extend, rather than replace, the original C50, U100 and nine-method environment disclosures. Historical/current driver equality is not established. The original five-IID-scenario seed-first aggregate is preserved byte for byte; no mean over the imbalanced six-scenario set is presented. All raw/native/shared 10/9/6-seed panels, selection history and prior official-test exposure remain disclosed. AEOD is the absolute TPR gap, not full equalized odds. This is exposed validation evidence, not an untouched test, a selected primary endpoint or a completed all-component image study.

changes.old: The five completed IID C scenes provide another bounded counterexample to a universal component-benefit claim. For IID F Flip, the native/shared paired ACC/AEOD/ASPD differences are +0.518±0.814 / +0.00139±0.01487 / +0.01098±0.02176, whereas raw gives +0.530±0.875 / +0.00465±0.01053 / +0.00703±0.01157 (ACC in percentage points; all values are means ± sample SD). Thus deletion improves accuracy but worsens both disparity means in the ten-seed panel. The native/shared F Flip AEOD difference is +0.00025±0.01530 in the nine-seed panel and -0.00291±0.01773 in the six-seed panel, showing that even its mean direction depends on the predefined subset. These descriptive results neither establish significance nor identify necessity or a causal mechanism. They do not extrapolate to the five non-IID C scenes or the other incomplete image controls.

**Non-IID Benign C-deletion extension.** The accepted [six-scene table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_C_six_scenes_20261010/snapshot/TABLES.md) adds ten matched non-IID Benign pairs, using the same round-70 checkpoint per model and 19,867 validation images. Native/shared Full ACC/AEOD/ASPD are 88.594 ± 1.168 / 0.00696 ± 0.00423 / 0.06511 ± 0.00902, compared with 89.188 ± 0.789 / 0.00615 ± 0.00668 / 0.06778 ± 0.00453 after deleting C (ACC in percent; gaps on [0,1]). The paired differences (minus_C−Full) are +0.594 ± 0.795 / -0.00081 ± 0.00644 / +0.00267 ± 0.00947 in native/shared and +0.641 ± 0.802 / +0.00105 ± 0.00915 / +0.00198 ± 0.00656 in raw, with ACC differences in percentage points; all triplets are means ± sample SD (ddof=1) across matched seeds. Removing C therefore increases accuracy in both views, lowers the native/shared AEOD mean slightly but increases ASPD, and increases both raw disparity means. These are retained trade-offs, not evidence that C benefits every metric or is universally indispensable. In the fixed nine- and six-seed native/shared panels, the corresponding paired triplets are +0.659 ± 0.814 / -0.00074 ± 0.00683 / +0.00332 ± 0.00980 and +0.518 ± 0.545 / -0.00000 ± 0.00681 / +0.00264 ± 0.00655. The accuracy and ASPD directions persist; the six-seed AEOD mean difference is close to zero (the displayed value rounds to zero), not evidence of equivalence. No significance or isolated aggregation-causality claim follows from these descriptive comparisons.

**C60 scope and comparability.** Only five IID scenarios and non-IID Benign are complete; the four non-IID attack scenarios and six other image controls remain incomplete. Native/shared metrics and saved group counts coincide for all 120 C60 records; the views are not independent replications. Full replay uses five CPU and 55 GPU records, with 59 cu128 and one cu130 training checkpoints; all 60 minus_C records use CPU replay and cu128 training. These C60 counts extend, rather than replace, the original C50, U100 and nine-method environment disclosures. Historical/current driver equality is not established. The original five-IID-scenario seed-first aggregate is preserved byte for byte; no mean over the imbalanced six-scenario set is presented. All raw/native/shared 10/9/6-seed panels, selection history and prior official-test exposure remain disclosed. AEOD is the absolute TPR gap, not full equalized odds. This is exposed validation evidence, not an untouched test, a selected primary endpoint or a completed all-component image study.
